# Purpose and interpretation

This reproducible analysis describes first observed Bay of Fundy (BoF) exit,
compares release cohorts, and evaluates uncertainty in exit classification for
kelts with a final pre-predation detection at an exit gate. It uses the same
cleaned detection, metadata, and finalized predation-event files as the habitat
GAM. It does not re-identify predation from a temperature threshold.

Three scenarios are evaluated with an identical analysis population:

1. **Primary:** confirmed exits plus final-gate assumed exits without subsequent
   inferred predation. Predated fish retain any earlier confirmed exit.
2. **Inclusive:** primary exits plus final-gate assumed exits among predated
   kelts without an earlier confirmed exit. This is the reviewer-requested
   alternative classification, not proof that those fish crossed the boundary.
3. **Confirmed only:** only detections outside the BoF establish an exit.

Kaplan–Meier (KM) estimates censor predation and other losses to observation.
They are conditional time-to-exit summaries, not estimates of the actual
probability of exiting before death or of continuous residence inside the Bay.
Log-rank tests are exploratory: release cohort is confounded with season, year,
condition, and time since release. No automatic conclusion is based solely on
whether a p-value crosses 0.05.

# Requirements and configuration

Place this file beside:

- `det_clean_no_release_site_det.rds`: `fish`, `dt`, `station`, `lon`, `lat`;
  optional `temp` and `receiver` are retained for audit.
- `predation_events_clean.rds`: one finalized event per fish, with `fish` and
  `predation_dt` (including the previously reviewed exclusion for Fish 72).
- `meta_clean.rds`: tag-level metadata with `fish`, `release_dt`; repeated fish/release records are collapsed.
- `recs_meta.rds`: full receiver metadata with `station`, `lon`, `lat`, `t`.

**Receiver input:** use the full `recs_meta.rds` produced by `Receiver_map.R`,
including its `t` receiver-type column. The import also accepts a CSV when
`receiver_file` is changed accordingly. No separate gate file is needed.

The exit gate is selected using the rule in `Receiver_map.R`:
` t == "gate" & lat < 44.83854 & lon > -66.91027 & lon < -66 `.
The selected stations and a gate-highlight map are exported for verification.
Explicit gate-station overrides remain available only when typed metadata are
unavailable. This document contains exit analyses; `migration_paths.Rmd` is the
standalone movement-figure workflow and does not need to be run first.

The original script's outside-Bay rule is deliberately retained for comparability:
longitude west of the westernmost gate receiver **and** latitude south of a fitted
gate line. This is a heuristic, not a full geographic BoF boundary, and can miss
exits elsewhere. A reviewed optional `outside_station_classification.csv` with
`station` and logical `outside_bay` overrides it for listed stations. Supply all
outside stations in that file when adopting a revised boundary definition.

The analysis population matches the predation analysis: all fish with a valid
post-release detection in the supplied cleaned file and an ID in the released
metadata, before predation truncation. All Minas Basin, BoF, and supplementary
receiver detections are retained. Receiver metadata define gates and recover
coordinates; they do not define fish inclusion. Missing locations cannot establish
an exit but are retained in the observation history. A fish detected only at or
after inferred predation remains in the denominator, is censored at inferred
predation, and has no live movement path. Such cases are exported for review.
Only the GAM uses a primary-grid restriction.

if (length(missing_packages)) stop("Install required packages: ",
                                   paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
invisible(lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE,

```{r settings}
receiver_file <- "recs_meta.rds" # Full typed receiver metadata
raw_receiver_file <- "RECEIVER DEPLOYMENT 2024-25[69].csv"
gate_file <- "exit_gate_receivers.csv"
gate_station_ids <- character(0) # Verified station names, if no separate gate CSV
outside_station_file <- "outside_station_classification.csv"
excluded_stations <- c("RELEASESITE", "Stewiacke River Park")
audit_window_hours <- 72 # Display only; full sequences are also exported
cohort_levels <- c("April", "December")
scenario_levels <- c("Primary", "Inclusive", "Confirmed only")
plot_colours <- c(April = "#56B4E9", December = "#003B73")
data_path <- function(x) file.path(params$data_dir, x)
dir.create(params$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
out_path <- function(x) file.path(params$output_dir, x)
export_csv <- function(x, name) readr::write_csv(x, out_path(name), na = "NA")
na_time <- as.POSIXct(NA, tz = "UTC")
parse_utc <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) return(lubridate::with_tz(x, "UTC"))
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) return(as.POSIXct(x, tz = "UTC"))
  lubridate::parse_date_time(as.character(x), orders = c("ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd"),
                             tz = "UTC", quiet = TRUE)
}
require_cols <- function(x, cols, label) {
  absent <- setdiff(cols, names(x))
  if (length(absent)) stop(label, " missing columns: ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
}
parse_flag <- function(x) {
  z <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  if (any(!is.na(z) & !z %in% c("true", "false", "1", "0")))
    stop("Logical classification must use TRUE/FALSE or 1/0.")
  ifelse(is.na(z), NA, z %in% c("true", "1"))
}
first_time <- function(x) if (length(x) && any(!is.na(x))) min(x, na.rm=TRUE) else na_time
last_time <- function(x) if (length(x) && any(!is.na(x))) max(x, na.rm=TRUE) else na_time
```

# Import and validate finalized data

No fish IDs, predation counts, exit counts, or historical percentages are hard-coded.
Fish identifiers are converted through character strings to avoid factor-code errors.
Release dates always come from biological metadata, not the first detection.

```{r import-data}
# Define paths directly without modifying params
data_dir <- "/Users/caliyenabrown/Documents/GitHub/IBoF-Salmon-Kelts-"
output_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "exit_outputs")
receiver_file <- "recs_meta.rds"

data_path <- function(x) file.path(data_dir, x)
out_path <- function(x) file.path(output_dir, x)

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

export_csv <- function(x, name) {
  readr::write_csv(x, out_path(name), na = "NA")
}

# Check required files
input_files <- c(
  "det_clean_no_release_site_det.rds",
  "meta_clean.rds",
  "predation_events_clean.rds",
  receiver_file
)

missing_files <- input_files[
  !file.exists(data_path(input_files))
]

if (length(missing_files) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Files missing from ", data_dir, ": ",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Import cleaned data
det <- base::readRDS(
  data_path("det_clean_no_release_site_det.rds")
)

meta_tag <- base::readRDS(
  data_path("meta_clean.rds")
)

pred <- base::readRDS(
  data_path("predation_events_clean.rds")
)

require_cols(
  det,
  c("fish", "dt", "station", "lon", "lat", "temp"),
  "Detections"
)

require_cols(
  meta_tag,
  c("fish", "release_dt"),
  "Metadata"
)

require_cols(
  pred,
  c("fish", "predation_dt"),
  "Finalized predation events"
)

# Collapse tag-level metadata to one release record per fish
meta <- meta_tag %>%
  transmute(
    fish = as.character(as.integer(as.character(fish))),
    release_dt = parse_utc(release_dt)
  ) %>%
  distinct(fish, release_dt)

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(meta$fish),
  !anyNA(meta$release_dt),
  !anyDuplicated(meta$fish)
)

# Assign cohorts from actual release dates
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    cohort = factor(
      case_when(
        lubridate::month(release_dt) == 4 ~ "April",
        lubridate::month(release_dt) == 12 ~ "December",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = cohort_levels
    )
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(meta$cohort))

# Prepare detections from all receivers
if (!"receiver" %in% names(det)) {
  det$receiver <- NA_character_
}

det <- det %>%
  transmute(
    fish = as.character(as.integer(as.character(fish))),
    dt = parse_utc(dt),
    station = as.character(station),
    lon = as.numeric(as.character(lon)),
    lat = as.numeric(as.character(lat)),
    temp = as.numeric(as.character(temp)),
    receiver = as.character(receiver)
  )

# Record exclusions before filtering
import_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  n_input = nrow(det),
  n_missing_fish = sum(is.na(det$fish)),
  n_missing_time = sum(is.na(det$dt)),
  n_identified_outside_metadata = sum(
    !is.na(det$fish) & !det$fish %in% meta$fish
  )
)

export_csv(
  import_audit,
  "detection_import_audit.csv"
)

# Match the predation-analysis population before predation truncation
det <- det %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(fish),
    !is.na(dt),
    fish %in% meta$fish
  ) %>%
  arrange(fish, dt)

detected_fish <- intersect(meta$fish, unique(det$fish))

stopifnot(length(detected_fish) > 0L)

analysis_meta <- meta %>%
  filter(fish %in% detected_fish)

export_csv(
  analysis_meta,
  "detected_fish_population.csv"
)

# Prepare finalized predation events
pred <- pred %>%
  transmute(
    fish = as.character(as.integer(as.character(fish))),
    predation_dt = parse_utc(predation_dt)
  )

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(pred),
  !anyDuplicated(pred$fish),
  all(pred$fish %in% meta$fish)
)

# Validate against the predation-analysis rule:
# first temperature >20°C, excluding Fish 72
expected_pred <- det %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(temp),
    temp > 20,
    fish != "72"
  ) %>%
  group_by(fish) %>%
  summarise(
    predation_dt = min(dt),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

predation_mismatch <- full_join(
  expected_pred %>%
    rename(expected_dt = predation_dt),
  pred %>%
    rename(finalized_dt = predation_dt),
  by = "fish"
) %>%
  filter(
    is.na(expected_dt) |
      is.na(finalized_dt) |
      expected_dt != finalized_dt
  )

export_csv(
  predation_mismatch,
  "predation_event_consistency_check.csv"
)

if (nrow(predation_mismatch) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Finalized predation events differ from the current detections. ",
    "Review predation_event_consistency_check.csv before continuing."
  )
}

# Attach metadata without restricting receiver stations
det <- det %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "fish") %>%
  left_join(pred, by = "fish") %>%
  arrange(fish, dt, station, receiver)

if (any(det$dt < det$release_dt)) {
  stop("Detections precede release; review timestamps.")
}

# Summarize the detected-fish population
population_summary <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    detected = fish %in% detected_fish
  ) %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(
    n_released = n(),
    n_detected = sum(detected),
    n_undetected = sum(!detected),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(population_summary)

export_csv(
  population_summary,
  "analysis_population.csv"
)

# Standardize receiver metadata column names
normalize_receivers <- function(x) {
  rename_map <- c(
    STATION = "station",
    `DEPLOY LON DD` = "lon",
    `DEPLOY LAT DD` = "lat",
    TYPE = "t"
  )

  for (old in names(rename_map)) {
    new <- unname(rename_map[[old]])

    if (old %in% names(x) && !new %in% names(x)) {
      names(x)[names(x) == old] <- new
    }
  }

  x
}

# Receiver metadata define gates and recover coordinates;
# they do not restrict detection or fish inclusion
recs <- base::readRDS(
  data_path(receiver_file)
)

recs <- normalize_receivers(recs)

require_cols(
  recs,
  c("station", "lon", "lat", "t"),
  "Full receiver metadata"
)

recs <- recs %>%
  mutate(
    station = as.character(station),
    lon = as.numeric(as.character(lon)),
    lat = as.numeric(as.character(lat)),
    t = tolower(trimws(as.character(t)))
  )

station_coords <- recs %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(station),
    is.finite(lon),
    is.finite(lat)
  ) %>%
  distinct(station, lon, lat)

if (anyDuplicated(station_coords$station)) {
  stop("Receiver metadata contain conflicting station coordinates.")
}

if (!any(recs$t == "gate", na.rm = TRUE)) {
  stop("No gate labels found in full receiver metadata.")
}
```

# Define and inspect the boundary

```{r gate-definition}
det <- det %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    "exit_gate", "outside_heuristic", "outside_override",
    "outside_bay", "marine", "location_class"
  )))

# Define exit-gate receivers
if ("t" %in% names(recs)) {

  recs <- recs %>%
    mutate(
      exit_gate = coalesce(
        t == "gate" &
          lat < 44.83854 &
          lon > -66.91027 &
          lon < -66,
        FALSE
      )
    )

  gates <- recs %>%
    filter(exit_gate)

} else if (file.exists(data_path(gate_file))) {

  gates <- readr::read_csv(
    data_path(gate_file),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  require_cols(
    gates,
    c("station", "lon", "lat"),
    "Gate table"
  )

} else if (length(gate_station_ids)) {

  if (!all(gate_station_ids %in% recs$station)) {
    stop("Configured gate stations are absent from receiver metadata.")
  }

  gates <- recs %>%
    filter(station %in% gate_station_ids)

} else if ("exit_gate" %in% names(recs)) {

  gates <- recs %>%
    filter(parse_flag(exit_gate) %in% TRUE)

} else {
  stop("Receiver metadata must include gate labels or verified gate stations.")
}

gates <- gates %>%
  transmute(
    station = as.character(station),
    lon = as.numeric(as.character(lon)),
    lat = as.numeric(as.character(lat))
  ) %>%
  distinct()

stopifnot(
  nrow(gates) >= 2L,
  !anyNA(gates),
  !anyDuplicated(gates$station),
  n_distinct(gates$lon) >= 2L
)

# Fit the original gate-line boundary
gate_model <- lm(lat ~ lon, data = gates)

gate_intercept <- unname(coef(gate_model)[1])
gate_slope <- unname(coef(gate_model)[2])
min_gate_lon <- min(gates$lon)

export_csv(gates, "exit_gate_stations.csv")

# Receiver coordinates available for filling missing detection locations
receiver_coordinates <- recs %>%
  transmute(
    station = as.character(station),
    receiver_lon = as.numeric(as.character(lon)),
    receiver_lat = as.numeric(as.character(lat))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(station),
    is.finite(receiver_lon),
    is.finite(receiver_lat)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

if (anyDuplicated(receiver_coordinates$station)) {
  stop("Receiver metadata contain conflicting coordinates for a station.")
}

# Additional coordinates from stations with one unique observed location
observed_coordinates <- det %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(station),
    !station %in% c("", "NA"),
    is.finite(lon),
    is.finite(lat)
  ) %>%
  distinct(station, lon, lat) %>%
  group_by(station) %>%
  filter(n() == 1L) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(
    observed_lon = lon,
    observed_lat = lat
  )

# Replace incomplete coordinate pairs, keeping the source pair together
det <- det %>%
  left_join(receiver_coordinates, by = "station") %>%
  left_join(observed_coordinates, by = "station") %>%
  mutate(
    coordinate_source = case_when(
      is.finite(lon) & is.finite(lat) ~ "Detection",
      is.finite(receiver_lon) & is.finite(receiver_lat) ~
        "Receiver metadata",
      is.finite(observed_lon) & is.finite(observed_lat) ~
        "Other detections at station",
      TRUE ~ "Unresolved"
    ),
    filled_lon = case_when(
      coordinate_source == "Detection" ~ lon,
      coordinate_source == "Receiver metadata" ~ receiver_lon,
      coordinate_source == "Other detections at station" ~ observed_lon,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    filled_lat = case_when(
      coordinate_source == "Detection" ~ lat,
      coordinate_source == "Receiver metadata" ~ receiver_lat,
      coordinate_source == "Other detections at station" ~ observed_lat,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    lon = filled_lon,
    lat = filled_lat
  ) %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    "receiver_lon", "receiver_lat",
    "observed_lon", "observed_lat",
    "filled_lon", "filled_lat"
  )))

# Identify gate detections and apply the original outside-Bay rule
det <- det %>%
  mutate(
    exit_gate = station %in% gates$station,
    outside_heuristic = lon < min_gate_lon &
      lat < gate_intercept + gate_slope * lon
  )

# Apply optional reviewed station classifications
if (file.exists(data_path(outside_station_file))) {

  outside_lookup <- readr::read_csv(
    data_path(outside_station_file),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  require_cols(
    outside_lookup,
    c("station", "outside_bay"),
    "Outside station table"
  )

  outside_lookup <- outside_lookup %>%
    transmute(
      station = as.character(station),
      outside_override = parse_flag(outside_bay)
    )

  stopifnot(
    !anyDuplicated(outside_lookup$station),
    !anyNA(outside_lookup)
  )

  det <- det %>%
    left_join(outside_lookup, by = "station")

} else {
  det$outside_override <- NA
}

# Preserve unresolved locations without assigning them to inside or outside
det <- det %>%
  mutate(
    outside_bay = case_when(
      exit_gate ~ FALSE,
      TRUE ~ coalesce(outside_override, outside_heuristic)
    ),
    marine = exit_gate |
      station %in% recs$station |
      coalesce(outside_bay, FALSE),
    location_class = case_when(
      exit_gate ~ "Gate",
      outside_bay %in% TRUE ~ "Outside",
      is.na(outside_bay) ~ "Unknown location",
      TRUE ~ "Inside boundary"
    )
  )

# Export unresolved records for review
unresolved_locations <- det %>%
  filter(location_class == "Unknown location")

export_csv(
  unresolved_locations,
  "unresolved_detection_locations.csv"
)

if (nrow(unresolved_locations) > 0L) {
  warning(
    nrow(unresolved_locations),
    " detections have unresolved locations. ",
    "They are retained but cannot establish an exit or an inside-Bay return. ",
    "See unresolved_detection_locations.csv."
  )
}
station_audit <- det %>% count(station,lon,lat,location_class,marine,name="n_records")
export_csv(station_audit,"station_classification_audit.csv")
knitr::kable(station_audit)
```

receiver_gate_map <- station_coords %>%
  mutate(exit_gate=station %in% gates$station) %>%
  ggplot(aes(lon,lat)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill=exit_gate),shape=21,colour="black",size=2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c(`FALSE`="grey65",`TRUE`="red"),
                    labels=c(`FALSE`="Other marine receivers",`TRUE`="Exit gate"),
                    name="Receiver group") +
  geom_abline(intercept=gate_intercept,slope=gate_slope,linetype="dashed") +
  coord_quickmap() + theme_bw() + labs(x="Longitude",y="Latitude")
receiver_gate_map
ggsave(out_path("receiver_exit_gate_map.png"),receiver_gate_map,width=10,height=6,dpi=300)
```

boundary_plot <- ggplot(station_audit, aes(lon, lat, colour=location_class)) +
  geom_point(na.rm=TRUE) + geom_point(data=gates, aes(lon, lat), inherit.aes=FALSE,
                            shape=4, size=3, colour="black") +
  geom_abline(intercept=gate_intercept, slope=gate_slope, linetype="dashed") +
  coord_quickmap() + theme_bw() + labs(x="Longitude", y="Latitude", colour="Classification")
boundary_plot
ggsave(out_path("boundary_classification.png"), boundary_plot, width=9, height=6, dpi=300)

# Build pre-predation histories

The inferred predation record itself is excluded from live movement histories.
Simultaneous detections at different stations are retained and flagged in the
reviewer audit; they are not assigned an arbitrary directional order. The
primary definition requires *all* detections at the final timestamp to be gate
detections before classifying a final-gate assumed exit.

```{r live-histories}
live_all <- det %>% filter(is.na(predation_dt) | dt < predation_dt)
# All fish in the predation-analysis detected population remain in exit analysis.
# No marine-table or primary-grid station filter is used here.
live <- live_all
# Fish with finalized predation but no corresponding raw detection remain flagged.
predation_record_check <- pred %>% left_join(
  det %>% distinct(fish, dt) %>% mutate(event_record_present=TRUE),
  by=c("fish", "predation_dt"="dt")) %>%
  mutate(event_record_present=replace_na(event_record_present, FALSE))
export_csv(predation_record_check, "predation_record_check.csv")
if (any(!predation_record_check$event_record_present))
  warning("Some finalized events have no matching detection; inspect predation_record_check.csv.")

fish_history <- bind_rows(lapply(detected_fish,function(id) {
  x <- live_all %>% filter(fish==id)
  last_dt <- last_time(x$dt)
  first_out <- first_time(x$dt[x$outside_bay %in% TRUE])
  preceding_gate <- if(!is.na(first_out))
    last_time(x$dt[x$exit_gate & x$dt<first_out]) else na_time
  final_rows <- if(nrow(x)) x %>% filter(dt==last_dt) else x
  tibble(fish=id,first_detection_dt=first_time(x$dt),last_live_dt=last_dt,
    final_timestamp_all_gate=nrow(final_rows)>0 && all(final_rows$exit_gate),
    final_timestamp_any_gate=any(final_rows$exit_gate),
    final_timestamp_n_stations=n_distinct(final_rows$station,na.rm=TRUE),
    first_out_dt=first_out,gate_before_out_dt=preceding_gate,
    n_live_records=nrow(x),n_days_detected=n_distinct(as.Date(x$dt)))
})) %>% left_join(meta,by="fish") %>% left_join(pred,by="fish") %>%
  mutate(confirmed=!is.na(first_out_dt),
    confirmed_time_fallback=confirmed & is.na(gate_before_out_dt),
    confirmed_exit_dt=coalesce(gate_before_out_dt,first_out_dt),
    final_gate_predated=final_timestamp_all_gate & !is.na(predation_dt),
    ambiguous_candidate=final_gate_predated & !confirmed,
    censor_dt=coalesce(predation_dt,last_live_dt))
stopifnot(nrow(fish_history)==length(detected_fish),
          setequal(fish_history$fish,detected_fish),!anyNA(fish_history$censor_dt))
export_csv(fish_history %>% filter(n_live_records==0),"no_pre_predation_observation.csv")
# Without a preceding gate record, use first outside detection as an upper-bound
# exit timestamp, rather than silently dropping a confirmed exit.
export_csv(fish_history, "fish_detection_summary.csv")
knitr::kable(fish_history %>% select(fish, cohort, confirmed,
  confirmed_time_fallback, final_gate_predated, ambiguous_candidate))
```

# Reviewer audit of final-gate predated fish

Counts are recalculated from current data. The broad group includes predated
fish with any gate detection at their final live timestamp, including fish with
an earlier confirmed exit. Only those with all final-timestamp records at gates
and no confirmed exit change classification in the inclusive scenario.

Full chronological sequences are exported for this broad group. The audit
reports the total number of gate detection occasions (unique timestamp and
station), the final uninterrupted run of gate occasions, time on that run, and
the interval from last live observation to inferred predation. Multiple pings
at one station do not establish a boundary crossing. No sequence is assigned a
confirmed return unless an outside observation is followed by an inside,
non-gate observation before inferred predation.

```{r reviewer-audit}
review_ids <- fish_history %>% filter(final_timestamp_any_gate, !is.na(predation_dt)) %>% pull(fish)
review_sequences <- det %>% filter(fish %in% review_ids) %>%
  mutate(phase=case_when(dt < predation_dt ~ "Pre-predation",
                         dt == predation_dt ~ "First predation observation",
                         TRUE ~ "Post-predation"),
         hours_from_predation=as.numeric(difftime(dt, predation_dt, units="hours"))) %>%
  arrange(fish, dt, station)
export_csv(review_sequences, "reviewer_full_detection_sequences.csv")
export_csv(review_sequences %>% filter(abs(hours_from_predation) <= audit_window_hours),
           "reviewer_detection_sequences_near_predation.csv")

review_audit <- bind_rows(lapply(review_ids, function(id) {
  x <- live_all %>% filter(fish == id) %>% arrange(dt, station)
  h <- fish_history %>% filter(fish == id)
  occasions <- x %>% distinct(dt, station, exit_gate)
  # Final gate run starts after the latest timestamp with a non-gate record.
  last_nongate <- last_time(occasions$dt[!occasions$exit_gate])
  terminal <- occasions %>% filter(exit_gate,
    is.na(last_nongate) | dt > last_nongate)
  event_rows <- det %>% filter(fish==id, dt==h$predation_dt)
  returns <- x %>% filter(location_class=="Inside boundary", !is.na(h$first_out_dt),
                           dt > h$first_out_dt)
  tibble(fish=id, cohort=as.character(h$cohort), earlier_confirmed_exit=h$confirmed,
    changes_in_inclusive=h$ambiguous_candidate,
    n_gate_raw_records=sum(x$exit_gate),
    n_gate_occasions=sum(occasions$exit_gate),
    n_gate_stations=n_distinct(x$station[x$exit_gate]),
    n_terminal_gate_occasions=nrow(terminal),
    terminal_gate_hours=if(nrow(terminal)) as.numeric(difftime(max(terminal$dt),
      min(terminal$dt), units="hours")) else NA_real_,
    last_live_dt=h$last_live_dt, predation_dt=h$predation_dt,
    hours_last_live_to_predation=as.numeric(difftime(h$predation_dt,h$last_live_dt,units="hours")),
    predation_stations=paste(sort(unique(event_rows$station)), collapse="; "),
    predation_location_classes=paste(sort(unique(event_rows$location_class)),collapse="; "),
    observed_inside_after_outside=nrow(returns)>0,
    simultaneous_final_stations=h$final_timestamp_n_stations)
}))
if (!length(review_ids)) review_audit <- tibble(fish=character(), changes_in_inclusive=logical())
export_csv(review_audit, "reviewer_gate_predation_audit.csv")
knitr::kable(review_audit, digits=2)
review_counts <- tibble(
  group=c("Any final-gate predated fish", "Additional inclusive exits"),
  n=c(length(review_ids), sum(fish_history$ambiguous_candidate)),
  denominator_predated_analyzed=sum(!is.na(fish_history$predation_dt)),
  denominator_all_analyzed=nrow(fish_history)) %>%
  mutate(percent_predated=if_else(denominator_predated_analyzed>0,
    100*n/denominator_predated_analyzed, NA_real_),
    percent_all_analyzed=100*n/denominator_all_analyzed)
knitr::kable(review_counts, digits=1)
export_csv(review_counts, "reviewer_counts_and_denominators.csv")

# First-exit classification and sensitivity analysis

Predation is censored at the first inferred predation observation, matching the
original script. Death occurred at an uncertain time between observations.
Each fish appears once per scenario; earlier confirmed exits always take
precedence. Assumed exits use the final live gate timestamp. Outside detections
without a preceding gate use their first outside timestamp, explicitly flagged
above as upper-bound exit times.

```{r scenario-function}
make_scenario <- function(history, scenario) {
  allow_assumed <- scenario != "Confirmed only"
  allow_predated <- scenario == "Inclusive"
  history %>% mutate(scenario=scenario,
    assumed=allow_assumed & !confirmed & final_timestamp_all_gate &
      (is.na(predation_dt) | allow_predated),
    exit_type=case_when(confirmed ~ "Confirmed", assumed ~ "Assumed",
                        TRUE ~ "No observed exit"),
    exit_dt=case_when(confirmed ~ confirmed_exit_dt, assumed ~ last_live_dt,
                      TRUE ~ na_time),
    event=as.integer(!is.na(exit_dt)), end_dt=coalesce(exit_dt,censor_dt),
    time_days=as.numeric(difftime(end_dt,release_dt,units="days")),
    changed_from_primary=scenario=="Inclusive" & ambiguous_candidate)
}
```

The following small checks exercise the classification logic independently of
study counts: a confirmed exit is preserved despite later predation; an ambiguous
fish changes only in the inclusive scenario; ordinary final-gate exits are
retained in the primary analysis; tied final gate/inside observations do not
create an assumed exit.

```{r classification-checks}
check_time <- as.POSIXct("2024-04-01", tz="UTC")
fixture <- tibble(fish=c("confirmed_predated","ambiguous","ordinary","tied"),
  release_dt=check_time, confirmed=c(TRUE,FALSE,FALSE,FALSE),
  confirmed_exit_dt=check_time+c(86400,NA,NA,NA),
  last_live_dt=check_time+2*86400,
  predation_dt=check_time+c(3*86400,3*86400,NA,3*86400),
  final_timestamp_all_gate=c(TRUE,TRUE,TRUE,FALSE),
  ambiguous_candidate=c(FALSE,TRUE,FALSE,FALSE),
  censor_dt=check_time+c(3*86400,3*86400,2*86400,3*86400))
check_primary <- make_scenario(fixture,"Primary")
check_inclusive <- make_scenario(fixture,"Inclusive")
check_confirmed <- make_scenario(fixture,"Confirmed only")
stopifnot(identical(check_primary$event,c(1L,0L,1L,0L)),
          identical(check_inclusive$event,c(1L,1L,1L,0L)),
          identical(check_confirmed$event,c(1L,0L,0L,0L)),
          check_primary$time_days[1]==1)
```

```{r scenario-data}
scenario_data <- bind_rows(lapply(scenario_levels, function(s)
  make_scenario(fish_history,s))) %>%
  mutate(scenario=factor(scenario,levels=scenario_levels))
stopifnot(!anyNA(scenario_data$time_days), all(is.finite(scenario_data$time_days)),
  all(scenario_data$time_days>=0),
  !anyDuplicated(scenario_data[c("fish","scenario")]),
  all(is.na(scenario_data$predation_dt) | scenario_data$event==0L |
        scenario_data$exit_dt < scenario_data$predation_dt))
export_csv(scenario_data,"exit_individual_scenarios.csv")
ci_binomial <- function(k,n) if(n>0) unname(binom.test(k,n)$conf.int) else c(NA_real_,NA_real_)
summarize_exits <- function(x) {
  k <- sum(x$event); n <- nrow(x); ci <- ci_binomial(k,n)
  tibble(n_analyzed=n,n_exits=k,n_confirmed=sum(x$exit_type=="Confirmed"),
    n_assumed=sum(x$exit_type=="Assumed"),n_censored=sum(x$event==0),
    exit_proportion=k/n,ci_lower=ci[1],ci_upper=ci[2])
}
exit_summary <- bind_rows(
  scenario_data %>% group_by(scenario,cohort) %>% group_modify(~summarize_exits(.x)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(cohort=as.character(cohort)),
  scenario_data %>% group_by(scenario) %>% group_modify(~summarize_exits(.x)) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(cohort="Combined"))
knitr::kable(exit_summary,digits=3)
export_csv(exit_summary,"exit_proportions_by_scenario.csv")
# A direct audit of changes prevents double-counting earlier confirmed exits.
change_table <- scenario_data %>% select(fish,cohort,scenario,exit_type,event,exit_dt) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=scenario,values_from=c(exit_type,event,exit_dt))
export_csv(change_table,"individual_classification_comparison.csv")
```

# Kaplan–Meier estimates and cohort tests

Raw exit proportions above and KM curves answer different questions. Exact
binomial intervals describe observed exit counts among analyzed fish; KM curves
also account for follow-up duration under their censoring assumptions. No fish
is described as continuously resident solely because no exit was observed.

```{r km-and-logrank, fig.width=12, fig.height=6, out.width="100%"}
km_fits <- list()
logrank_results <- list()
km_rows <- list()
for (s in scenario_levels) {
  x <- scenario_data %>% filter(scenario==s) %>% droplevels()
  fit <- survival::survfit(Surv(time_days,event) ~ cohort, data=x)
  km_fits[[s]] <- fit
  km_rows[[s]] <- survminer::surv_summary(fit,data=x) %>% mutate(scenario=s)
  # No test is reported if there are no exits or fewer than two represented cohorts.
  if (sum(x$event)>0 && n_distinct(x$cohort)==2) {
    test <- tryCatch(survival::survdiff(Surv(time_days,event) ~ cohort,data=x),
                     error=function(e) e)
    if (!inherits(test,"error") && is.finite(test$chisq)) {
      test_df <- length(test$n)-1L
      logrank_results[[s]] <- tibble(scenario=s,chisq=unname(test$chisq),df=test_df,
        p_value=pchisq(test$chisq,df=test_df,lower.tail=FALSE),status="Estimated")
    } else logrank_results[[s]] <- tibble(scenario=s,chisq=NA_real_,df=NA_integer_,
      p_value=NA_real_,status="Not estimable")
  } else logrank_results[[s]] <- tibble(scenario=s,chisq=NA_real_,df=NA_integer_,
    p_value=NA_real_,status="Insufficient events or cohorts")
  # Export the full plot with risk table for each classification scenario.
  p <- survminer::ggsurvplot(fit,data=x,conf.int=TRUE,risk.table=TRUE,
    censor=TRUE,pval=FALSE,palette=unname(plot_colours[levels(x$cohort)]),
    legend.title="Release cohort",legend.labs=levels(x$cohort),
    xlab="Days since release",ylab="Probability of no observed exit",
    title=s,break.time.by=50,ggtheme=theme_bw(base_size=12))
  if (s == "Primary") {
    p$plot <- p$plot + theme(legend.position="top")
    p$table <- p$table + theme(axis.title.x=element_blank())
  }
  print(p, surv.plot.height=0.78, risk.table.height=0.22)
  slug <- gsub(" ","_",tolower(s))
  combined <- survminer::arrange_ggsurvplots(
    list(p), ncol=1, nrow=1, print=FALSE,
    surv.plot.height=0.78, risk.table.height=0.22
  )
  # Primary manuscript figure uses a wide landscape layout, including risk table.
  figure_width <- if (s == "Primary") 12 else 10
  figure_height <- if (s == "Primary") 6 else 8
  ggsave(out_path(paste0("km_exit_",slug,".png")),combined,
         width=figure_width,height=figure_height,units="in",dpi=300,bg="white")
}
logrank_table <- bind_rows(logrank_results)
knitr::kable(logrank_table,digits=4)
export_csv(logrank_table,"logrank_tests_by_scenario.csv")
km_data <- bind_rows(km_rows)
export_csv(km_data,"km_estimates_by_scenario.csv")
saveRDS(km_fits,out_path("km_exit_fits.rds"))
```

```{r sensitivity-overlay, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Include time zero so step curves start at one.
curve_data <- bind_rows(
  km_data %>% transmute(scenario,cohort=as.character(cohort),time,surv),
  scenario_data %>% distinct(scenario,cohort) %>%
    transmute(scenario=as.character(scenario),cohort=as.character(cohort),time=0,surv=1)) %>%
  mutate(scenario=factor(scenario,levels=scenario_levels)) %>% arrange(scenario,cohort,time)
overlay <- ggplot(curve_data,aes(time,surv,colour=cohort,linetype=scenario,
                               group=interaction(cohort,scenario))) +
  geom_step(linewidth=0.8) + scale_colour_manual(values=plot_colours) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,1)) + theme_bw(base_size=12) +
  labs(x="Days since release",y="KM probability of no first observed exit",
       colour="Release cohort",linetype="Classification")
overlay
ggsave(out_path("km_sensitivity_overlay.png"),overlay,width=10,height=6,dpi=300)
# Quantify differences on a common within-cohort follow-up grid.
km_at <- function(fit,times,cohort) {
  z <- summary(fit,times=times,extend=TRUE)
  tibble(time=z$time,stratum=as.character(z$strata),survival=z$surv) %>%
    filter(stratum==paste0("cohort=",cohort)) %>% pull(survival)
}
curve_difference <- bind_rows(lapply(levels(droplevels(scenario_data$cohort)),function(cc) {
  horizon <- scenario_data %>% filter(cohort==cc) %>% group_by(scenario) %>%
    summarise(end=max(time_days),.groups="drop") %>% summarise(end=min(end)) %>% pull(end)
  times <- sort(unique(c(0,scenario_data$time_days[scenario_data$cohort==cc &
                                                  scenario_data$time_days<=horizon])))
  a <- km_at(km_fits[["Primary"]],times,cc)
  b <- km_at(km_fits[["Inclusive"]],times,cc)
  tibble(cohort=cc,comparison_horizon_days=horizon,
         max_absolute_KM_difference=max(abs(a-b)),
         primary_KM_at_horizon=tail(a,1),inclusive_KM_at_horizon=tail(b,1))
}))
knitr::kable(curve_difference,digits=3)
export_csv(curve_difference,"km_primary_inclusive_difference.csv")
```

# Calendar timing of first observed exits

This panel shows individual exit dates under the primary classification, rather
than a calendar-time survival curve. Release dates are marked separately for
each cohort. Small vertical offsets separate individual fish; they have no
biological meaning. Event counts are not adjusted for the number of fish under
observation. Dates use UTC, consistent with the analysis timestamps.

```{r calendar-exit-panel, fig.width=12, fig.height=3.5, out.width="100%", fig.cap="Calendar timing of first observed Bay of Fundy exits under the primary classification. Symbols distinguish confirmed and assumed exits; numbers identify individual fish. Diamonds mark cohort release dates. Vertical offsets separate observations and have no biological meaning. Event dates represent assigned exit times and are not estimates of seasonal exit probability."}
primary_calendar <- scenario_data %>%
  filter(as.character(scenario) == "Primary")

calendar_exits <- primary_calendar %>%
  filter(event == 1L, !is.na(exit_dt)) %>%
  mutate(
    exit_date = as.Date(exit_dt, tz = "UTC"),
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("December", "April")),
    exit_type = factor(exit_type, levels = c("Confirmed", "Assumed"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(cohort, exit_dt, fish) %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  mutate(
    # Spread points without changing their actual calendar dates.
    vertical_offset = if (n() == 1L) 0 else seq(-0.16, 0.16, length.out = n()),
    row_position = as.numeric(cohort) + vertical_offset
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

calendar_releases <- primary_calendar %>%
  transmute(
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("December", "April")),
    release_date = as.Date(release_dt, tz = "UTC"),
    row_position = as.numeric(cohort)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

calendar_exit_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = calendar_releases,
    aes(release_date, row_position),
    shape = 23, fill = "white", colour = "black", size = 3.5, stroke = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = calendar_releases,
    aes(release_date, row_position, label = "Release"),
    nudge_y = 0.30, size = 3.3
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = calendar_exits,
    aes(exit_date, row_position, shape = exit_type, colour = cohort),
    size = 3, stroke = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = calendar_exits,
    aes(exit_date, row_position, label = fish, colour = cohort),
    nudge_y = 0.08, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = "Exit classification",
    values = c(Confirmed = 16, Assumed = 2), drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = plot_colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 2), labels = c("December release", "April release"),
    limits = c(0.65, 2.5)
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "2 months", date_labels = "%b\n%Y",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.06))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Calendar date", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

calendar_exit_plot
export_csv(calendar_exits, "primary_exit_calendar_dates.csv")
ggsave(out_path("primary_exit_calendar_panel.png"), calendar_exit_plot,
       width = 12, height = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(out_path("primary_exit_calendar_panel.pdf"), calendar_exit_plot,
       width = 12, height = 3.5, units = "in", bg = "white")

# Reporting checklist and reproducibility

Use `reviewer_counts_and_denominators.csv` to report the affected number with an
explicit denominator. Use `reviewer_gate_predation_audit.csv` and the full
sequences to discuss whether gate observations were single occasions or repeated
observations, their timing, earlier confirmed departures, and observed returns.
A repeated gate record alone cannot distinguish movement across the boundary
from continued presence within receiver range or tidal transport.

Report primary and inclusive exit counts and cohort percentages from
`exit_proportions_by_scenario.csv`, cohort log-rank results from
`logrank_tests_by_scenario.csv`, and the magnitude of curve changes from
`km_primary_inclusive_difference.csv`. Do not add fish already classified as
confirmed exits a second time. Do not copy historical sample sizes or claim
robustness before inspecting the generated results. Inspect boundary flags and
any missing gate-before-outside timestamps before finalizing the manuscript.

Differences from the original exploratory script include finalized predation
events, validated metadata joins, exclusion of the predation observation from
live histories, explicit treatment of simultaneous records, the same all-receiver detected-fish
population as the predation analysis, no double-counting of confirmed exits, and preservation
of actual release dates. Movement figures are produced separately by `migration_paths.Rmd`. Changes in counts can therefore reflect
corrected preprocessing as well as the exit-classification sensitivity analysis.

```{r reproducibility}
settings_used <- list(receiver_file=receiver_file,gate_file=gate_file,
  gate_station_ids=gate_station_ids,outside_station_file=outside_station_file,
  outside_rule="Original west-of-westernmost-gate AND south-of-fitted-line heuristic; optional station overrides",
  excluded_stations=excluded_stations,audit_window_hours=audit_window_hours,
  predation_censor_time="First finalized inferred predation observation",
  analysis_population="All detected fish retained by the predation analysis before predation truncation")
saveRDS(settings_used,out_path("analysis_settings.rds"))
input_files <- c("det_clean_no_release_site_det.rds","predation_events_clean.rds",
                 "meta_clean.rds",receiver_file,gate_file,outside_station_file)
input_files <- unique(input_files[file.exists(data_path(input_files))])
export_csv(tibble(file=input_files,md5=unname(tools::md5sum(data_path(input_files)))),
           "input_checksums.csv")
capture.output(sessionInfo(),file=out_path("exit_session_info.txt"))
```
